Name: Better Shopping - Adventurer
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever just sighed to yourself wishing you could just go buy a second furnace, kegs, some wooden paths or even battery packs? Well now you can! Better Shopping will add all of the Vanilla Machines, Resources, Decor and more! If you can craft it you can purchase it! To give you a little more challenge and self restraint most things are not purchasable until you have acquired their crafting recipe or met some other conditional. More info on the other conditionals below. Every single item in this mod is configurable as in you can decide if you want to have the items be purchasable and for how much! Make your shopping experience as easy or as hard as you would like it to be.

This Mod: Adventurer[/size]
